violated_contract: A terminal hide for a stale capture must preserve every audio byte and every content field, record the prior lifecycle fields, and expose an undo that restores them exactly. A hide that drops the prior state, enters a deletion pipeline, or cannot be undone turns a near-empty capture into unrecoverable data loss.
canonical_prevention: Close only through the lifecycle owner's snapshot-fenced storage primitive: stamp the reviewed hidden terminal shape, save the prior status/discarded/terminal_no_derived_effects values in a marker, and restore them exactly on operator undo. Never call a deletion helper, never remove an audio object, and refuse a row that another owner retired, locked, merged or admitted to finalization.
